subject: Receipt printer offline – Terminal 1 not printing orders since morning
description: The receipt printer connected to POS Terminal 1 (asset POS-0022-T1) has stopped responding since approximately 6:45 AM today. When staff attempt to print orders, the FoodTech POS v4.2.3 system displays error code E-PRINT-502 ('Printer communication timeout'). The printer (Zebra TLP 2844Z model) is powered on, has paper loaded, and shows a solid green light, but no print jobs are being processed. We have already attempted the following troubleshooting steps: (1) restarted the POS terminal, (2) checked USB cable connections—all secure, (3) reinstalled printer drivers via Device Manager, (4) cleared the print queue on the host computer, (5) tested with a direct USB test print from Windows—no response. The issue persists across all order types (dine-in, takeaway, delivery). This is impacting service delivery during peak breakfast hours; customers are waiting 8–10 minutes longer while staff manually write receipts. We need urgent resolution to restore normal operations. Store is operating at 70% efficiency due to manual workaround. POS terminal otherwise functioning normally; issue is isolated to printer communication.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and reviewed. Customer has completed comprehensive local troubleshooting. Error E-PRINT-502 suggests firmware or driver communication issue. Remote printer status check initiated from backend—printer responding to network ping but not accepting print jobs.

Advised store manager to power cycle printer for 2 minutes and check for firmware update availability in POS settings. Escalation flagged due to P3 priority + business impact during peak hours. Assigned to L2 Hardware Support team for remote diagnostics.
